articles.title: The Duskbloods Playtest Was Even More Popular Than Elden Ring Nightreign’s
articles.title_tr: The Duskbloods Playtest Was Even More Popular Than Elden Ring Nightreign’s
articles.summary:
It sounds like fans were eager to learn everything they could about From Software's The Duskbloods, as one of the game's producers has revealed the Switch 2 exclusive saw higher playtest sign-ups compared to Elden Ring Nightreign.



Speaking during a livestream hosted by Japanese gaming publication Famitsu (and translated by GamesRadar+), From Software producer Yasuhiro Kitao stated the number of applications for The Duskbloods playtest eclipsed that of the developer's previous multiplayer experiment.



"We were really surprised," Kitao said. 



Given that Elden Ring Nightreign's playtest was available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (the full game was also available on PC and last-gen consoles) the fact that The Duskbloods received more interest on Switch 2 sounds like it should be impossible. The Switch 2 is also a relatively new console, having only been available for around a year, meaning its user base is much smaller compared to that of the other two consoles.




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PK2m1pr27q0




While it is surprising on the surface, perhaps there is some logic to be deciphered here. Elden Ring Nightreign went on to sell more than 5 million copies, with its DLC alone selling 2 million copies in under a week. The game's popularity and success proved From Software could make a wildly fun, multiplayer-focused souls-like, perhaps generating more interest for The Duskbloods.



It also probably helped that there was almost no information known about The Duskbloods prior to the closed network test, encouraging players who wanted to learn more to sign up. While players knew it was multiplayer in nature, the exact structure of The Duskbloods, its playable classes, and its mechanics were all a mystery. The Duskbloods being helmed by legendary From Software director Hidetaka Miyazaki also doesn't hurt.



Such a large number of playtest applications bodes well for The Duskbloods, even if the network test got off to a rough start with server and connectivity issues that saw From Software cancel its first session. The test also served as the world's first introduction to Zork, one of the game's playable characters that has already become a bit of a meme.



GameSpot's Jake Dekker came away impressed during his hands-on The Duskbloods preview, saying he'd "never played anything like it" and "couldn't wait to play more." The Duskbloods is still slated to release sometime this year but does not currently have a release date.

articles.title: I Can’t Believe I Missed Mortal Shell 2’s Best Item, Silly Me
articles.title_tr: I Can’t Believe I Missed Mortal Shell 2’s Best Item, Silly Me
articles.summary:
From awesome Tarstones to exceptional weapons, there are a lot of really good items to find in Mortal Shell 2. While you can miss them if you're not doing your due diligence while exploring, there's an early-game item that you really don't want to miss because of how it trivializes most fights. Unfortunately for me, I missed it and realized way too late, so let me regale you with my troubles in the hopes that you don't make the same mistake as I did.



The first boss you fight happens in the prologue. After some light exploration and acquiring your first shell, Haros, you roll up on the Tar Golem, who absolutely wrecks your stuff. It's designed as a forced loss, so actually putting up a fight is pointless, especially since a cutscene plays showing that Haros saves your life anyway.



It's here that you loot your now-dead shell for the Vatra's Seal, which hardens your body to nullify incoming damage and freezes you mid-animation. It's actually a pretty overpowered seal. Not only does it cancel out damage, causing enemies to get knocked back if they attack your shell, but it also acts as an animation cancel, letting you interrupt your attacks by hardening your body to guard. Time the harden just right and you've got a perfect parry, which deals massive posture damage and eventually leads to a counterattack.



Vatra's Seal is essentially the main ability from the first Mortal Shell. But instead of it being tied to one specific shell, when you loot Haros' corpse in the sequel, you can harden your body no matter which shell you currently have equipped. It rules.



Sadly, I totally missed out on this item.



Having played--and loved--the beta, I had the option to skip the prologue and get a handful of goodies, including the Vatra's Seal, for free. My silly self insisted I replay the prologue simply because, and right after the Tar Golem fight, I--for whatever reason--just ... sprinted to the next area.



So, boom. Haros goes down, I move on, and before I know it, I'm inside Proxima, hookshotting from enemy to enemy and dealing tons of lightning damage. It rules. Except, hm ... something was missing. I check my seals maybe 10 or 15 hours into the game and see that I don't have the Vatra's Seal. So, I Google, wondering if there's a way I can recollect it despite not looting Haros' body and being too far into the game to restart at this point. And, no. Once you leave the prologue area, there's no way to go back and collect the seal.



Cue the biggest, longest sigh you've ever heard.



I'm making do with the Untarnished Seal, which is one of four seals (or three, if you missed the Vatra's Seal as I did) in the game. It's ... fine. You get a guard that blocks you from incoming damage until your posture meter is broken, at which point you enter a prolonged vulnerable state. And if you guard at the right moment, you can perfect-parry attacks.



But the Untarnished Seal is no Vatra's Seal. And while the Infinite Seal lets you animation cancel, you don't get a guard, so missing your parry means you take damage. The Vatra's Seal really is the best of both worlds, as it negates all damage when used, freezes your body mid-animation, and still gives you a perfect parry. And I completely missed it.



So, dear player, I implore you: If you're jumping into Mortal Shell 2 for the first time, make sure you loot Haros' body. Even if you don't end up using the Vatra's Seal the entire game, you'll be grateful to have the option. Because I don't even have that.



Anyway, developer Cold Symmetry has released a pretty helpful patch for the game that makes some welcome changes, including nerfing bosses and increasing the amount of gold you find in the world. What's not helpful, though, are the bear traps, which are getting on players' nerves.

articles.title: Bursa'da da eş zamanlı baskın! Kendilerini MİT ve banka çalışanı olarak tanıttılar
articles.title_tr: Bursa'da da eş zamanlı baskın! Kendilerini MİT ve banka çalışanı olarak tanıttılar
articles.summary:
Aydın merkezli yürütülen ve Bursa'nın da aralarında bulunduğu 8 ili kapsayan dolandırıcılık operasyonunda 7 şüpheli tutuklandı. Kendilerini MİT personeli ve banka çalışanı olarak tanıtarak vatandaşlardan para aldığı belirlenen şüphelilerin hesaplarındaki para trafiğinin 255 milyon 696 bin liraya ulaştığı tespit edildi.Aydın İl Jandarma Komutanlığı ekipleri tarafından yürütülen teknik ve istihbari çalışmalar sonucunda, çeşitli vaatlerle vatandaşlardan para talep eden bir suç örgütü tespit edildi. Şüphelilerin kimliklerini gizlemek amacıyla kendilerini farklı kamu kurumlarında görevli personel ve banka çalışanı olarak tanıttıkları belirlendi.

Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu (MASAK) kayıtları üzerinden yapılan incelemede, şüphelilere ait hesaplarda dikkat çekici bir para hareketliliği ortaya çıktı. Yapılan incelemelerde toplam 255 milyon 696 bin liralık para trafiği tespit edildi.

8 İLDE OPERASYON, ÇOK SAYIDA DİJİTAL MATERYAL ELE GEÇİRİLDİ

Jandarma ekipleri, belirlenen 8 şüpheliye yönelik düğmeye bastı. Aydın merkezli operasyon kapsamında Bursa, İstanbul, Adana, Kocaeli, Ankara, Gaziantep ve Kastamonu'da eş zamanlı baskınlar gerçekleştirildi.

Bursa hava durumu

Şüphelilerin adreslerinde yapılan aramalarda 7 cep telefonu, 2 flaş bellek, dizüstü ve masaüstü bilgisayar ile harici hard diskin yanı sıra 84 bin 570 avro nakit para ele geçirildi.

7 ŞÜPHELİ CEZAEVİNE GÖNDERİLDİ

Operasyonda yakalanan 7 şüpheli, jandarmadaki işlemlerinin tamamlanmasının ardından adliyeye sevk edildi. Hakimlik karşısına çıkarılan şüphelilerin tamamı tutuklanarak cezaevine gönderildi.

Hakkında yakalama kararı bulunan diğer şüphelinin yakalanması için ekiplerin çalışmalarının sürdüğü bildirildi.

articles.title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Is Way Ahead Of Black Ops 7 Already By One Metric
articles.title_tr: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Is Way Ahead Of Black Ops 7 Already By One Metric
articles.summary:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is nearing 400,000 copies sold on Steam already, and that's well ahead of where last year's Black Ops 7 stood at launch on Valve's platform. This is according to Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics, who added that pre-sales on Steam alone work out to around $21 million in revenue.



Elliott said Black Ops 7 managed to hit around 200,000 copies pre-sold on Steam by launch. Modern Warfare 4 has doubled that, and with two months still to go before release.



Modern Warfare 4 is selling well so far on Steam, it seems.



MW4's beta put up big numbers on Steam during its early-access period, reaching a peak of more than 115,000 concurrent users. Black Ops 7, meanwhile, peaked at about 100,000 concurrent users on Steam, even after it went live for everyone outside of a beta weekend, according to ChalieIntel.



MW4 performing better than Black Ops 7 by some metrics already is not a total surprise, as last year's game was a commercial disappointment. In fact, its sales ranking in the US was the lowest for the series since 2008. 



The next MW4 beta is coming up this weekend, running August 28-September 1. This will be an open beta, so anyone on any platform can play without needing to preorder. Additionally, this beta will extend to Nintendo Switch 2.



MW4 is expected to have stronger outright sales overall in part on PC because it is not included with PC Game Pass like Black Ops 7 was.



Impact on console sales



Elliott also observed that MW4 could help improve sales of PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles. MW4 is the first entry in the series since 2013's Call of Duty: Ghosts to skip PS4 and Xbox One, so the launch of MW4, combined with the current-gen-only GTA 6, will "for sure nudge the last-gen holdouts," Elliott said. 



The newest consoles are more expensive than ever today, thanks to a variety of factors, including tariffs, AI, and the capitalistic demands to always make more money. As such, anyone buying a new console to play MW4 or GTA 6 who hasn't kept up with the news is in for a shock at the register or online checkout. For its part, Microsoft is encouraging people to buy a used console or use a Buy Now, Pay Later service to help fund the cost of an expensive new console. 



MW4 launches on October 23, while GTA 6 arrives at long last on November 19.

articles.title: ABD, Suriye'yi "terörü destekleyen ülkeler" listesinden çıkardı
articles.title_tr: ABD, Suriye'yi "terörü destekleyen ülkeler" listesinden çıkardı
articles.summary:
ABD Dışişleri Bakanlığı, Suriye'yi "terörü destekleyen ülkeler" listesinden çıkarırken ABD Hazine Bakanlığı, Suriye’nin artık "Terör Listesindeki Hükümetlere Yönelik Yaptırımlar Yönetmeliği" kapsamındaki yasaklara tabi olmadığını bildirdi. Açıklamada, El Nusra Cephesi olarak da bilinen Heyet Tahrir Şam’ın (HTŞ) "Özel Olarak Belirlenmiş Küresel Terörist" ve "Özel Olarak Belirlenmiş Vatandaşlar ve Engellenmiş Kişiler" statüsünün de kaldırıldığı belirtildi. ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio, söz konusu gelişmenin, özel sektör yatırımlarının Suriye’ye yönelmesinin önündeki son önemli engelleri ortadan kaldırdığını açıkladı.ABD'den Suriye’de devrik lider Beşar Esad dönemi sonrasındaki normalleşme sürecine yönelik önemli bir adım geldi. ABD Dışişleri Bakanlığı, Suriye’yi "terörü destekleyen ülkeler" listesinden çıkardı.

ABD Hazine Bakanlığı’na bağlı Yabancı Varlıklar Kontrol Ofisi’nden (OFAC) yayımlanan bildiride, Suriye’nin artık "Terör Listesindeki Hükümetlere Yönelik Yaptırımlar Yönetmeliği" kapsamındaki yasaklara tabi olmadığı belirtildi.

Hazine Bakanlığı ayrıca, El Nusra Cephesi olarak da bilinen Heyet Tahrir Şam’ın (HTŞ) "Özel Olarak Belirlenmiş Küresel Terörist" ve "Özel Olarak Belirlenmiş Vatandaşlar ve Engellenmiş Kişiler" listelerinden çıkarıldığını bildirdi.

"ÖZEL SEKTÖR YATIRIMLARININ SURİYE’YE YÖNELMESİNİN ÖNÜNDEKİ SON ÖNEMLİ ENGEL KALKTI"

ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio duruma ilişkin yazılı açıklamasında, söz konusu gelişmenin zorunlu 45 günlük ABD Kongresi bilgilendirme sürecinin tamamlanmasının ardından geldiğini belirtti. Rubio, "Bu adımlar, Başkan Donald Trump’ın Suriye halkına refaha ulaşma yolu açma yönündeki tarihi girişimlerinin bir başka önemli aşamasını oluşturuyor" dedi.
Rubio, "Trump yönetimi, son bir yıl içerisinde Suriye halkının yararına yaptırımların hafifletilmesi amacıyla daha önce görülmemiş adımlar attı. Haziran 2025’te çıkarılan Suriye yaptırımlarının kaldırılmasının sağlanmasına yönelik tarihi başkanlık kararnamesi, Suriye’ye yönelik yaptırımların hafifletilmesi sürecini hızlandırdı" ifadelerini kullandı.

ABD Dışişleri Bakanı, "Bu adımların tamamı, Suriye Devlet Başkanı Ahmed eş-Şara yönetimindeki Suriye hükümetinin uluslararası terör eylemlerinden tamamen uzaklaşma yönünde attığı olumlu adımlar ve verdiği ilave taahhütler dikkate alınarak atıldı. Suriye’nin Terörü Destekleyen Ülke statüsünün ve HTŞ’nin Özel Olarak Belirlenmiş Küresel Terörist statüsünün kaldırılması, özel sektör yatırımlarının Suriye’ye yönelmesinin önündeki son önemli engelleri ortadan kaldırarak, ülkenin ekonomik toparlanmasını ve küresel ekonomiye yeniden entegre olmasını destekliyor" dedi.

SURİYE’NİN NORMALLEŞME SÜRECİ VE ŞAM’IN DIŞ POLİTİKASI

HTŞ, Suriye’nin devrik lideri Beşar Esad rejiminin devrilmesinde önemli rol oynayan grupların başında gelmişti. Mevcut Suriye Devlet Başkanı Ahmed eş-Şara, HTŞ’nin liderliğini üstlenmişti. Eş-Şara, Esad rejiminin Aralık 2024’te devrilmesinin ardından geçici devlet başkanı olarak görev yapmaya başlamıştı.

Esad sonrası dönemde normalleşme sürecine giren Suriye, ABD ve Batılı ülkelerle ilişkilerini yeniden tesis etmeye yönelik adımlar atarken, Washington’ın son kararı Şam yönetimine yönelik uluslararası baskının azaltılması açısından önemli bir gelişme olarak değerlendiriliyor.

articles.title: Eskişehir'de lastiği patlayan araç bariyerlere girdi: 1’i çocuk 3 yaralı
articles.title_tr: Eskişehir'de lastiği patlayan araç bariyerlere girdi: 1’i çocuk 3 yaralı
articles.summary:
Eskişehir'den Ankara istikametine seyir halinde olan otomobilin lastiğinin patlaması sonucu meydana gelen trafik kazasında 1'i çocuk 3 kişi yaralandı. Kaza, Eskişehir-Ankara kara yolu Sivrihisar ilçesine 10 kilometre kala meydana geldi. Edinilen bilgiye göre, Sibel B. idaresindeki 06 ENR 388 plakalı otomobil, Ankara istikametine doğru ilerlerken sağ ön lastiğinin patlaması sonucu kontrolden çıktı. Yalpalayan araç, yol kenarındaki bariyerlere çarparak durabildi.

Meydana gelen kazada sürücü Sibel B., araçta yolcu olarak bulunan M.A.B. ve kız çocuğu H.S.K. yaralandı. Çevredeki diğer sürücülerin ihbarı üzerine olay yerine jandarma ve sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi. Yaralılar, olay yerinde yapılan ilk müdahalenin ardından ambulanslarla çevredeki hastanelere kaldırılarak tedavi altına alındı.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaks: A Timeline Of The Events So Far
articles.title_tr: GTA 6 Leaks: A Timeline Of The Events So Far
articles.summary:
It's been a busy few weeks for Rockstar and Take-Two following a series of  leaked GTA 6 gameplay videos and images. Beginning in mid-August 2026, an anonymous individual or group calling itself CyberLeek began publishing unreleased Grand Theft Auto 6 material. The first wave included gameplay videos and apparent images of the GTA 6 map.



The situation is still unfolding, so we've got a roundup of all of the events of the most recent GTA 6 leak in chronological order, along with what the footage appears to show, and CyberLeek's communications so far. Ahead of the footage being posted more widely, several Reddit users believe that infrastructure including the main CyberLeek domain and backup spelling variants were registered as early as August 14. They also claim that a $CYBERLEEK token, liquidity pool, website, and voting program were created around August 15.



August 18



Jason plays basketball



The first clip was around a minute long, and showed protagonist Jason Duval outside the oceanside house that's already been seen in official Rockstar marketing material. It showed off a Focus mechanic, where making a basket increased Jason's Focus level, as shown on the HUD. It's unclear whether this Focus system is present across all of the gameplay, or only in minigames such as basketball. It was initially unclear whether the footage was genuine, but as Rockstar begin issuing DMCA takedown notices, it appeared to verify the legitimacy.



CyberLeek's manifesto



Accompanying the first leak were some "commandments" from CyberLeek, including:




Thou Shalt Not Sell Digital Preorders



Thou Shalt Not Sell Fake Single-Player DLC



Thou Shalt Preserve Single-Player Content




CyberLeek's clearest complaint is around digital preorders. It argues that this doesn't benefit customers since the product is a digital download that cannot sell out. GTA 6 will not be released on a physical disc, despite having physical premium editions available.



Jason's road confrontation



The second clip to surface on August 18, titled Random Video 1, showed Jason driving before becoming involved in an altercation with an NPC. It appeared to show that a wide variety of items can be used as weapons, including a wrench. 



So far, CyberLeek has only shown footage of Jason's gameplay.



The map



Also on August 18, CyberLeek published images purporting to show the map of GTA 6's city, Leonida. GTA mapping communities have extensively researched the images and found that numerous details line up with years of reconstructed information from Rockstar's official marketing materials. The map appears to be made up of a series of in-game screenshots stitched together to show the entire open world.



August 19



Taser video



A third video appeared to show Jason breaking into a facility and using a taser, which would be a new type of weapon for the series if it's in the final build. Many theorized this clip could be from 2025 at the earliest, since it featured a track by Tate McRae that was released in January 2025. It shows Jason could be capable of cloning keys or smashing windows when near vehicles. Jason also seems to collect a hat from the ground and put it on. Vehicle-health and fuel-status bars are shown, too.



After a short cut away, Jason and his friend drink beers on a boat while laughing about using a VPN. Quite apt.



Junkies 



A fourth video, titled Junkies, showed Jason kicking a police officer off a motorcycle before stabbing him and driving away on it. It showed a potential wanted level of six stars, something that didn't feature in GTA 5. He then approached a community living underneath a bridge, and as Jason's wanted level increased, a warning appeared on the UI stating that the cops are looking for him and have his description.



It also showed the use of something called Zombix, which will apparently have a weaker effect on your health the more you use it. Bystanders also seem to have the ability to report your crimes.



Stop Killing Games distances itself



Stop Killing Games--an international consumer campaign that hopes publishers will keep purchased games in a playable state after official support ends--has distanced itself from CyberLeek and its tactics. "Using illegal means to make a point is unacceptable to us," it said. 




https://twitter.com/StopKilingGames/status/2089892615923622375?s=20




It also urged people to not buy the CyberLeek memecoin. "Do not send these people your money, no matter how much sympathy you may feel for their actions," it explained.



The polls begin



CyberLeek has a memecoin called $CYBERLEEK that appears on all of the watermarked footage. This cryptocurrency's value depends on internet speculation or attention, and CyberLeek said that its token would fund a "secret project." There's been no word so far on what that secret project might be. 



As an incentive for people to purchase the token, CyberLeek began running polls for users to decide on the footage they wanted to view next. Whichever poll option had the most tokens purchased against it would be the next released footage. One poll asked users to choose between a car during the day, a car at night, a motorcycle at night, or a plane during the day. The plane won, with 64.4% of the total, leading to the release of the plane video.



August 20



Extended gameplay



This video was the one that really got people talking, as some theorized that the leaker may have access to a playable build of the game. As Jason flew over the city in a plane, it showed the density of the environment, and added new locations. A few radio stations are scrolled through, giving a better idea of what the GTA 6 soundtrack could sound like. However, the most important moment was when the character apparently was directly controlled and used gunfire to spell "Leek" on a nearby wall.



Ending threats



At the same time, CyberLeek threatened to release further material, including potential story and ending spoilers, unless Rockstar and other publishers change their approach to digital games. Some of the videos feature watermarked threats such as, "No physical discs? Then more leeks!" 



August 21



Subpoenas



Rockstar parent company Take-Two filed multiple subpoenas requesting that Microsoft and Discord assist it in discovering CyberLeek's identity by providing information on its users. One subpoena filed with the Southern District Court of New York on August 20 showed that it was issuing DMCA takedown notices in order to "obtain the identity of an alleged infringer or infringers," adding that the information would only be used to protect Take-Two's rights.



Take-Two has asked Microsoft and Discord to come up with the internal records before September 4, asking for information including Discord account IDs, registration emails, IP addresses, linked connections, and more. 



According to Discord itself, as of the afternoon of August 24, the company has not yet been served with a subpoena.



Seeking advertisers



A new "Contact" tab appeared on the CyberLeek website on August 21 that stated that the individual or group responsible is looking for funds "through community support and strategic partnerships" by selling ad space on its forthcoming leaks. It stressed that this is not a "ransom," though, so that's okay. It'll set those interested back a 400 XMR (Monero) fee, which currently converts to just shy of $165,450. And that's just the fee to contact those responsible.



First hypercar video



The next video to surface is the first hypercar video, which shows Jason driving through the streets in the Truffade Thrax--a car that's currently in GTA Online--performing burnouts and taking part in some pretty irresponsible driving. As far as content goes, it's one of the more uneventful leaked videos, but it does give a good idea of how the city could look at sunset.



August 22



Strip club teaser



This video began with Jason driving the same hypercar as the previous video, with smoke coming from the tires and engine. He then pulled into a gas station, refueled the car, and ran into the shop. Jason appeared to punch the shopkeeper and steal some cash. He then robbed another gas station before crashing into a barrier and damaging the car significantly. Afterwards, Jason is seen approaching a strip club and walking in. The video's watermarked message reads, "3mil marketcap = stripclub." It was interpreted that this meant if the $CYBERLEEK coin hit a market cap of 3 million, the full strip club video would be released.



The leaks just keep on coming.



Strip club



As teased earlier on, the next video to leak showed a strip club with Easy Rider branding, which could be the name of the establishment. It's got all of the behavior you'd expect from such a place, including large warnings to not "come on to the dancers." There are plenty of neon lights, NPCs, more leaked soundtrack titles, and Jason even uses some binoculars to get a better look at the dancers. At the end of the clip, a cutscene inside a men's bathroom is shown and Jason interacts with another NPC.



August 23



Wasted



Another day, another leaked video. This time, Jason drove a car to the gas station. It appears to be Jason's personal vehicle--the Vapid Ganado. An NPC is spilling fuel on the floor while talking to themselves until Jason steals his truck and drives off, running him over as he goes. As he drives off, Jason crashes into another vehicle and both of them explode. Here, we see what appears to be the GTA 6 "Wasted" screen as Jason dies.



After a short cut, the video returns to yesterday's leaked footage of Jason in the urinals and a quest prompt telling him to return to Lucia. This is the first time Lucia has been mentioned in the leaked footage.



Fake GTA 6 downloads



There are multiple copies of an apparent 113GB GTA 6 file circulating around the internet, but it appears to be padded malware. According to Tom's Hardware, testers say the file is 99.99% empty zeroes, with the remaining space taken up by a 50KB virus. Apparently, downloading and opening that file will whitelist your entire C:\ drive in Windows Defender and kill all of your security software. Probably don't touch that, then.



August 24



Yet more nudity



A new clip showing leaked GTA 6 footage found its way online on August 24, showing a nudist colony in Leonida. Jason's walking around near a pool and several hot tubs while dozens of naked people dance nearby. While some of them don't seem bothered by his presence, after he looks at a woman with binoculars, she physically attacks him. The leak shows the most detailed nudity I've ever seen in a game before, which is equal parts impressive and alarming.



The most notable detail though, if you can draw your eyes away from all the genitalia, is the watermark. "Do you want a Lucia-led prologue? CL has been evading spoilers," it reads. CyberLeek has put up another poll, and asked gamers to show up dressed as leeks in front of the Take-Two and Rockstar offices while holding physical game discs.



As the leaks continue--with more threats being made, and Take-Two seemingly not much closer to identifying CyberLeek--if you're trying to avoid spoilers, you should consider adding filters to your social-media feeds to remove any mentions of GTA or CyberLeek. As this story continues to develop, we'll update the timeline with new events.

There are multiple copies of an apparent 113GB GTA 6 file circulating around the internet, but it appears to be padded malware. According to Tom's Hardware, testers say the file is 99.99% empty zeroes, with the remaining space taken up by a 50KB virus. Apparently, downloading and opening that file will whitelist your entire C:\ drive in Windows Defender and kill all of your security software. Probably don't touch that, then.



August 24



Yet more nudity



A new clip showing leaked GTA 6 footage found its way online on August 24, showing a nudist colony in Leonida. Jason's walking around near a pool and several hot tubs while dozens of naked people dance nearby. While some of them don't seem bothered by his presence, after he looks at a woman with binoculars, she physically attacks him. The leak shows the most detailed nudity I've ever seen in a game before, which is equal parts impressive and alarming.



The most notable detail though, if you can draw your eyes away from all the genitalia, is the watermark. "Do you want a Lucia-led prologue? CL has been evading spoilers," it reads. CyberLeek has put up another poll, and asked gamers to show up dressed as leeks in front of the Take-Two and Rockstar offices while holding physical game discs.



As the leaks continue--with more threats being made, and Take-Two seemingly not much closer to identifying CyberLeek--if you're trying to avoid spoilers, you should consider adding filters to your social-media feeds to remove any mentions of GTA or CyberLeek. As this story continues to develop, we'll update the timeline with new events.
